Fixed localized floating-point width calculation in `include/fmt/format.h`.

The formatter now counts thousands separators using the integral-digit count (`exp`) rather than the full significand in the fixed-point fractional branch. This prevents an extra character from being included in the padding width when the localized output has a short integral part.
